correctness.rationale: A full weak cycle endomorphism idempotent fixes its image, and a proper connected image is a cyclic arc of ell+1 vertices. Complementary path must follow length n-ell confined lazy walk ell→0 on [0,ell]; transfer B_ell gives the exact polynomial E_n(z)=z^n+nz+n sum_{ell<=floor(n/2)} (B_ell^(n-ell))_{ell,0}z^(ell+1). ell=1 and maximal ell produce the two sharp coefficient specializations. B_ell eigenvalues 1+2cos(j*pi/(ell+2)) and endpoint first spectral coefficient ~ell^-3 show for ell=t n^(1/3) the exponent deficit [t log3 + pi²/(3t²)]n^(1/3); compact-range spectral separation plus global tail bounds yield unique minimizer a=(2pi²/(3log3))^(1/3), b=(3/2)a log3, log I_n=n log3-bn^(1/3)+o(n^(1/3)), and exponential-scale rank concentration. Independent fresh enumeration all maps n=3..9 against transfer counts and all rank boundaries. A malformed doubled math delimiter in the source exposition around Phi(t) does not alter the well-defined formula but is a publication formatting issue.
residual_risks: Bounded checking corroborates examples, not unrestricted quantified mathematics.

originality.rationale: The 2023/2024 Dimitrova et al. monoid paper is genuinely the same weak full cycle endomorphism monoid and supplies image-arc/rank bounds, Green relations, regularity, and TOTAL monoid cardinalities. Its inspected results do not supply coefficientwise IDENTITY-RETRACTION counts by image size nor the n^(1/3) limiting rank law. Other path weak-homomorphism counts are not idempotent cycle retraction distributions.
